units.source_text: 众侍女都觉得奇怪：“敢是身体不舒服么？”

en.t: All the waiting women found it strange and wondered, "Could she be feeling unwell?"

units.source_text: 源氏公子要暂回东殿去，先将笔砚盒拿进去放在寝台的帐幕中，然后离去。

en.t: Prince Genji was about to return briefly to the eastern wing, so he first took the writing box inside and placed it within the curtains of the bed, then left.

units.source_text: 紫姬知道室内无人，好容易抬起头来，向四周一看，

en.t: Lady Murasaki, realizing that no one was in the room, finally managed to raise her head and look around.

units.source_text: 但见枕边放着一封打成结的信。

en.t: There beside her pillow she saw a letter folded and tied in a knot.

units.source_text: 无心地随手打开来一看，

en.t: Without thinking, she casually opened it and looked.
Inside, she saw two lines of poetry written there:
